<div class="hatnote wv-hatnote">''This article is the magic-system overview. For the in-world concept, see [[sacred arts]].''</div>
'''Sacred Arts''' is one of the magic systems of the Willverse.

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Sacred Arts represent a field of knowledge and practice focused on refining the [[spirit]] to achieve a connection with all of creation. Practitioners use these arts to manipulate the world by utilizing [[madra]], which serves as their internal power and the raw material of souls. This resource can be cycled, refined, circulated through limbs, or exhausted. As practitioners advance through various realms, they undergo physical transformations; for example, reaching the [[Iron stage]] following [[Copper]] allows an artist to forge their body and expel impurities. This results in a [[madra]]-reinforced constitution that provides [[superhuman strength]], speed, and improved vision. The ultimate goal of any path is the [[Gold stage]], where a practitioner masters the secrets of [[madra]] beyond mortal [[dreams]] and possesses a body partially composed of [[madra]]. Beyond human [[advancement]], animals and humans leave behind [[Remnants]] as they grow in power. These are living forces consisting of [[pure madra]] that remain after death, appearing as bright emerald sketches or outlines. Certain specialized forms include the tree-[[Remnant]], a purple skeletal construction, and specific disciplines like the [[Path of the White Fox]], which cultivates light and [[dreams]] to create illusions and deceive the senses.}}
